rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the substances
negated compound indicating absence of mantra
conditional particle introducing a hypothetical case

items.question: What is the ritual condition when these substances are offered to Śaṅkara without a mantra?
premises: The substances in question are specific ritual offerings.
These offerings may be given without an accompanying mantra.
Śaṅkara is the intended recipient of the offerings.
items.inference: The verse presents the case of substances offered to Śaṅkara without mantra as a distinct ritual condition.
uncertainties: The consequence of offering without mantra is not stated within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: If these substances are given to Śaṅkara without a mantra.
